A book is primarily made of paper pages bound together within a cover, typically containing text, images, or both.

Cryptocurrency refers to a digital or virtual form of currency that uses cryptography for security and operates independently of a central bank. It is used for peer-to-peer transactions, as a store of value, and increasingly as a medium of exchange for goods and services, facilitated by blockchain technology.
